amendments.why: scripts/check-devdocs-freshness.sh requires a dossier or decision record for the behaviour change under bin/lean/

R1 audit: every gh exec reachable from the daemon already carries a timeout (engine-cli makeIo 10s, effects.mjs run 120s, runWithInput, drift 60s); the one untimed gh exec (decisions list, engine-cli) now has 60s. Defunct children are reaped by libuv's SIGCHLD handler once the event loop runs; the cause was loop starvation, which the lag watchdog now logs, so no manual reaping is added. A timed-out host() start is deliberately not cancelled: aborting would orphan or duplicate a batch whose lanes are already launched; the caller gets an error and other batches are served.
